items.title: A finite type module flat along a fibre is flat on an open after an elementary etale neighbourhood
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite type variant of the flat along the fibre statement: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base there is an open subset of the base change containing the fibre on which the pullback of the finite type module is flat (statement lines 2794-2812, tag 05KV). The proof applies the pointwise statement at the points of the quasi-compact fibre, passes to finitely many points, chooses one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and then takes the union of the inverse images of the pointwise opens, which contains the fibre and on which the pullback is flat. The assembling of the open set is the substance, so the claim is H2.
